description: The professional Telegram layout (owner, 2026-10-18): each mutation breaks one thing a trader reads -- the signal's time, its side, its stop rule, its risk:reward, or which signal a close-the-loop message names. Run from backend/: uv run python -m tests.support.mutation_battery tests/mutations/notifier_pro_format.json

mutations.name: the signal time is the candle OPEN, a period before the setup existed
a short is told its stop closes below
mutations.old: closes = "candle close below" if direction == "UP" else "candle close above"

mutations.name: risk is measured from the proximal edge instead of the zone mid
a short's reward runs to the target's far edge
mutations.old: near = target[0] if up else target[1]

mutations.name: a long is announced as a short
the close-the-loop query no longer reads which signal it closes
mutations.old: join detection.signals s on s.signal_id = t.signal_id

mutations.name: an outcome loses its headline and is announced by its raw code
